facts.statement: Microvenator is a genus of small theropod dinosaur belonging to the Oviraptorosauria group.
facts.quote: Microvenator (meaning "small hunter") is a genus of oviraptorosaurian theropod dinosaur

facts.statement: The holotype fossil is an incomplete skeleton likely belonging to a juvenile measuring 1.3 meters in length.
facts.quote: The holotype fossil is an incomplete skeleton, most likely a juvenile with a length of 1.3 m

facts.statement: Barnum Brown collected the type specimen AMNH 3041 in 1933.
facts.quote: Barnum Brown collected the type specimen (AMNH 3041) in 1933

facts.statement: Barnum Brown erroneously included Deinonychus teeth with the Microvenator type specimen.
facts.quote: he erroneously included Deinonychus teeth with the specimen

facts.statement: Barnum Brown informally named the specimen "Megadontosaurus" meaning "big-toothed lizard".
John Ostrom originally classified Microvenator within Othniel Marsh's Coeluridae family.
facts.quote: Ostrom originally theorized it was part of Othniel Marsh's Coeluridae

facts.statement: John Ostrom referred a single tooth from the Yale Peabody Museum collection (YPM 5366) to Microvenator.
facts.quote: Ostrom also referred a single tooth from the Yale Peabody Museum collection, YPM 5366, to this new species

facts.statement: Microvenator lived during the mid-Cretaceous, approximately 110 million years ago, in the Aptian stage.
facts.quote: que vivió a mediados del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente 110 millones de años , durante el Aptiense

facts.statement: Microvenator fossils have been discovered in the states of Montana and Wyoming, USA.
facts.quote: Los restos fósiles del Microvenator se descubrieron en los estados de Montana y Wyoming, en los Estados Unidos

facts.statement: Microvenator is considered a primitive taxon and may be the sister group to all other oviraptorosaurs.
facts.quote: Microvenator is primitive and may be the "sister taxon to all other oviraptorosaurs."

facts.statement: Microvenator likely had a carnivorous diet, though an omnivorous tendency is not ruled out.
facts.quote: Al igual que otros pequeños terópodos, es probable que presentara una dieta carnívora, aunque no se descarta una tendencia omnívora

facts.statement: Microvenator coexisted with dinosaurs such as Deinonychus, Sauropelta, and Acrocanthosaurus.
facts.quote: Microvenator coexisted with notable dinosaurs like Deinonychus, Sauropelta, and Acrocanthosaurus

facts.statement: Microvenator is the earliest known member of the oviraptorosaurian group from North America.
facts.quote: They confirmed that Microvenator is an oviraptorosaurian, and that it is the earliest known member of this group from North America

facts.statement: Microvenator is classified within the infraorder Oviraptorosauria.
Microvenator belongs to the family Oviraptoridae.
The Paleobiology Database lists the parent group of Microvenator as Caenagnathidae.
It is unclear why some sources attribute Microvenator to the genus Microraptor.
facts.quote: Las razones de la atribución al género Microraptor no están claras
